axisDefinition: Volume-equivalent ellipsoid; the axes are the stated ratios with Z as the spin axis. With unit ratios this is a sphere.
measurement: HiRISE observation during the Mars flyby, reported as a roughly 1 km non-spherical body in a conference abstract
scaleQualification: The published effective nucleus radius is used as a volume-equivalent display radius. This is an explicit scale convention, not a measured volume or set of physical axis lengths.
qualification: Smooth parameter-based approximation of an unresolved nucleus. Reported non-spherical with an 8.00 hour period; the abstract states no axis ratio, so a sphere is displayed. No local shape features, concavities, surface textures, coma or tail are claimed.
